title: 第五章 新的凶手出现
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

黎雾心里陡然一惊，叹了一口气，满脸生无可恋的坐上陆云铮的黑色轿车。

从最开始来时追刀疤脸的紧张不同，这次回去的氛围难得的轻松了几分。

黎雾坐在副驾驶上玩手机，正玩得开心呢，突然陆云铮的声音响起：

“黎雾，你是怎么知道周大军有问题的。”

“是看见过他作案？之前怎么不说。”

黎雾正在玩手机的手一顿。

她就知道，随着周大军的抓捕归案，确定他就是绑架徐倩文的凶手，迎接自己的就是审问。

要把自己眼睛看到周大军头顶写着【绑架案凶手】这件事告诉陆云铮吗？

这个念头在脑海中快速划过，但是很快就被黎雾给毫不留情的否认。

一来，她并不觉得自己会那么倒霉，接下来还会遇见各种各样的凶手。

二来，黎雾已经能够想象得到，这么诡异的事情但凡说出来，接下来指不定就是没完没了的验证。

作为社恐，她最讨厌的就是和人接触。

想到这里

黎雾垂下眼，指尖无意识的在屏幕上点了点，吐出两个字答案：

“直觉。”

“我只是直觉他有问题，想要试试。”

陆云铮目光落在黎雾在屏幕上轻点的指尖上。

这是身体下意识的紧张焦虑行为。

黎雾在撒谎？

为什么？

陆云铮下意识的觉得黎雾身上有很重的谜团，让他忍不住出声探究反问道：

“真的吗？”

这一次黎雾没有回答。

难言的安静在车厢之中蔓延。

黑色轿车一路直达，最终停在了位于云城市中心的老小区聚集地。

狭小的巷子让黑色轿车无法直接开进楼栋脚下，眼见着熟悉的建筑，黎雾无声的松了一口气，主动道：

“陆警官，就送到这里吧，我就先回去了。”

陆云铮紧急开口道：

“等等，我们加个联系方式。”

“今天救出徐倩文，你提供的线索功不可没。”

“等后面案件处理完，我这边会向上申请奖励，徐倩文这边应该也会联系你感谢。”

毕竟是首富独女。

对于救命之恩，多多少少，都会给一笔钱。

黎雾看着递到自己面前的二维码，犹豫一二后，拿出手机扫描，提交了好友信息。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Li Wu was suddenly startled, sighed, and got into Lu Yunzheng's black car with a look of despair on his face.

Different from the tension of chasing Scarface when I first came, the atmosphere when I went back this time was rare and relaxed.

Li Wu was sitting in the passenger seat playing with his mobile phone. He was having fun when suddenly Lu Yunzheng's voice sounded:

"Li Wu, how did you know there was something wrong with Zhou Dajun?"

"Did you see him commit a crime? Why didn't you tell me before?"

Li Wu paused while playing with his cell phone.

She knew that as Zhou Dajun was arrested and brought to justice, it was confirmed that he was the murderer who kidnapped Xu Qianwen, and she would be interrogated.

Do you want to tell Lu Yunzheng that you saw "Kidnapping Murderer" written on Zhou Dajun's head with your own eyes?

This thought flashed through his mind quickly, but was quickly denied mercilessly by Li Wu.

At first, she didn't think she would be so unlucky, and she would meet all kinds of murderers next.

Secondly, Li Wu could already imagine that if such a weird thing was said, there might be endless verifications next.

As a social phobic, what she hates most is contact with people.

Think of this

Li Wu lowered his eyes, tapped his fingertips on the screen unconsciously, and spit out the two-word answer:

"Intuition."

"I just had a gut feeling that something was wrong with him and wanted to give it a try."

Lu Yunzheng's eyes fell on Li Wu's fingertips tapping on the screen.

This is the body’s subconscious behavior of stress and anxiety.

Li Wu is lying?

Why?

Lu Yunzheng subconsciously felt that there was a serious mystery surrounding Li Wu, so he couldn't help but inquire aloud and asked:

"Really?"

This time Li Wu didn't answer.

An unspeakable silence spread in the carriage.

The black car drove all the way and finally stopped at the gathering place of the old community in the center of Yuncheng City.

The narrow alley prevented the black car from driving directly into the foot of the building. Seeing the familiar building, Li Wu breathed a silent sigh of relief and said proactively:

"Officer Lu, just send it here. I'll go back first."

Lu Yunzheng said urgently:

"Wait a minute, let's add contact information."

"The clues you provided are indispensable for rescuing Xu Qianwen today."

"When the subsequent cases are processed, I will apply for rewards from here, and Xu Qianwen will also contact you to thank you."

After all, she is the only daughter of the richest man.

For life-saving grace, some amount of money will be given.

Li Wu looked at the QR code handed to him. After hesitating for a moment, he took out his mobile phone to scan and submitted his friend information.
